set.body:
Outcome: an owner-approved ADR 0019 amendment defines the smallest compatible public contract before new vocabulary or execution authority is implemented.
Scope: ADR 0019, actual MappingPipeline/MappingRun/MappingResult/StageProvenance/ExpectedMappingContext/codec and organization consumer seams.
Acceptance: specify selectable existing checked reconstruction/decision policies and explicit source-bound grouping; a complete selected single-level reference cut; mode selection for paired versus reference-only; original-input origin/registration proof for reference records and organization authority; member-specific availability, identities, schema versioning and legacy decoder behavior. Policies select candidates before pricing across lexical, caption and ONNX paths. Declare default compatibility including canonical endpoint bytes, run/config identities, historical presets and refusal behavior; list deliberate version changes. Retain current no-fill Sherlock-only weighted v1 compatibility; unsupported selections refuse explicitly. Define how a reference-only result reaches MappingResult, codec, exchange, temporal and organization consumers without a fake paired Execution or weakened existing constructor. Prefer a bounded reference producer/adapter seam over a generalized execution framework. Record rejected alternatives and exact owner decision. If approval is pending, leave blocked with the concrete decision; this planning request is not ADR approval.
Evidence: outside-module failing consumer specifications for reference-only authority and nonzero-level selection, with same-shape controls; source/caller crosswalk and independent design review. Announce governing-file edits before making them.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
set.title: [mapping audit D] Agree selectable-policy and reference-only producer contracts
